heading_en: General Provisions on Back-Testing and Profit-and-Loss Attribution Tests
summary_ja: 内部モデル方式採用最終指定親会社が行うテスト(全社的・各デスクのバック・テスティング、損益要因分析テスト)と、デスクの合格要件を定める。
summary_en: Lists the tests an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach must perform and requires each internal-model trading desk to pass the desk-level tests.

sections_en.第二節 第三款: Requirements for Back-Testing and Profit-and-Loss Attribution Tests

paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach shall conduct the following tests. (i) Enterprise-wide back-testing. (ii) Back-testing for each trading desk. (iii) The profit-and-loss attribution test for each trading desk.
A trading desk that uses the internal model approach shall have passed the tests listed in items (ii) and (iii) of the preceding paragraph.
